value.produces: Apollo DN3500 boot ROMs + Domain/OS SR10.4.1 winchester image staged; golden savestate at the Display Manager (OPEN — see DOMAINOS-WAVE.md)

labctl.notes: HOST-NATIVE: MAME 0.276 dn3500 (Apollo DN3500) runs on the host — no QEMU, no QMP, no exec channel. Frames drawshm->shm, keys ctlsock through the generated keymap, no audio. PINNED TO 0.276, NOT the fleet's 0.289: on 0.289 every Normal-mode boot is black forever (the boot ROM's keyboard self-test spins on the SIO). Keys need 180 ms per edge — at the fleet floor of 80 the Shift key lands one character late. Pointer transport is none: the emulated Apollo keyboard never leaves compatibility mode, so its mouse ports are never sampled (proven with gdb; see docs/guests/domainos.md). Launcher stations/mame-native/x11-runtime.sh.

render.stationsManifestPrelude:
# domainos (VMID 192) — Apollo DN3500, Domain/OS SR10.4.1: the Display
# Manager desktop, host-native MAME dn3500 pinned to 0.276.

museum.periodBrowser: none — Apollo Domain networking (802.3), no era web browser on this station
museum.blurb: Apollo's Domain/OS on a DN3500 workstation. The Display Manager tiles the screen with 'pads' instead of stacking windows, keeps a command line along the bottom edge, and treats every machine on the network as another branch of one file system.
museum.notes: Host-native MAME dn3500, pinned to 0.276 (0.289 hangs this machine's Normal-mode boot). Keyboard-only: the pointer is an OPEN item with a known cause and a known unlock — see docs/guests/domainos.md. The guest clock reads 2003 because the boot ROM's CALENDAR check had to be answered once by hand when the disk was composed; cosmetic, and visible in the process display.

reset.mouse: None. The Apollo 3-button mouse hangs off the keyboard and apple2e's open-loop stack is compiled in and configured, but apollo_kbd's scan timer samples the mouse ports only when the keyboard has left KBD_MODE_0_COMPATIBILITY, and Domain/OS never sends the 0xFF 0x01 that would do it (gdb dprintf on set_mode: zero hits across boot, login and a count burst). The DM is driven from the keyboard instead.
reset.keyboard: Apollo serial keyboard, 1200 baud. PROVEN on the framebuffer at the Display Manager: 'echo Apollo DN3500 Domain/OS SR10.4.1' typed and echoed byte-perfect at 180 ms per key edge. At the fleet floor of 80 ms the Shift key leaks one character late ('APollo dN#500'). The shifted number row is DEC-style, not US (shift-8 is '(', shift-2 is '"'); spa/src/data/keyboards.ts carries the charMap. MAME names Backspace, Tab and Return all 'Unnamed Key' on this driver, so the keymap pins them by KEYCODE token (mame-ctlsock-field-token.patch).
reset.fixture: The Display Manager desktop, logged in as user: pad0000 with a /com/ld / listing of the Domain/OS root and a /com/lcnode node table, an empty shell pad, and the process display, over the DM's Command: bar. Baked with MAME SAVEST on the post-CALENDAR disk; the pristine media halts in the boot ROM's 14-day CALENDAR check and is never the station disk.

notes: scaffolded from samcoupe on 2026-09-09 (--like samcoupe --tuple towerA,homeCrtD,none,none); native shape is samcoupe/apple2e
MAME is pinned to 0.276 for this station via NATIVE_MAME_TAG in native.d/domainos.sh — the fleet's 0.289 cannot boot the DN3500 in Normal mode (docs/lab/DOMAINOS-WAVE.md wall 1)
the station disk is the POST-CALENDAR disk composed by tiles/domainos.sh; the pristine media image halts in the boot ROM
pointer OPEN: the emulated Apollo keyboard never leaves compatibility mode, so its mouse ports are never sampled — next step is making Domain/OS send 0xFF 0x01 (docs/guests/domainos.md)
